rationale: The bid-ask spread is exceptionally wide at 44.2 bps ($0.27), which consumes nearly half of the 5-minute ATR ($0.58) upon entry. While upward momentum following the earnings beat is strong—evidenced by the latest 1-minute candle closing at the session high of $61.25 on surging volume—price is already extended nearly two ATRs above the 5-minute 9-EMA ($59.98), making a long entry poor risk-reward and a short entry premature against strong buying pressure.
